annotations.title: AI testers (10 synthetic users + QA report)

description: AI website testing: 10 AI testers (synthetic users) try a website and say what they think it is, where they got stuck, whether they would come back or pay and the one fix, plus a QA report: about 35 automated accessibility, SEO, security, performance, mobile and broken-link checks and an expert bug hunt (UX, accessibility, security, conversion, mobile, localization) with severity, steps and fixes. Use for fast, cheap first-impression feedback on a website, landing page or web app before a launch or after a redesign, or to compare two pages. Pass url, plus optional audience, market (country or region the testers live in, default a global mix), up to 5 questions and language (any). Each call returns 10 different personas; for more, call again with offset set to the previous response's nextOffset. Returns summary {understoodPct, avgFirstImpression, avgWouldComeBack 1-5, wouldPayPct, topIssues[] {issue, count, examples}, topLikes[], fixFirst, verdict}, strangers[] {persona, thinksItIs, understood, firstImpression, gotStuck[], liked[], wouldComeBack, wouldPay, oneFix, quote, answers[]}, pagesRead[] and qa {checks {score 0-100, areaScores, checks[] {id, area, status pass/warn/fail, title, detail, fix}}, bugs[] {area, severity, title, where, steps, expected, actual, fix}, bugCounts} (qa=false skips it). Simulated from the page text (home page plus up to two key pages), not real people or a real browser; sites that need JavaScript to show text can't be judged. For real people, or phone apps, order human testers at exepal.com/user-testing. Not charged when the site can't be read. Price: $1.00 USDC per call (x402 on Base); not charged if the call fails.

audience.description: Optional: who the site is for, e.g. small shop owners in Nepal

language.description: Optional: language for the answers, e.g. Spanish, German, Japanese, Hindi (default English)

market.description: Optional: country or region the testers live in, e.g. United States, Germany, Brazil, India (default a global mix from 20+ countries)

offset.description: Persona number to start from (default 0). Pass nextOffset from a previous call to get 10 new visitors

qa.description: Include the QA report: about 35 automated accessibility, SEO, security, performance, mobile and broken-link checks plus an expert bug hunt with severity and fixes (default true, no extra charge)

questions.description: Optional: up to 5 questions every visitor answers, e.g. Would you sign up? What would you pay?

url.description: Website to test, e.g. https://example.com (home page; up to two key pages such as pricing or sign-up are read too)

name: strangers_ai

nextOffset.description: Pass as offset to get new visitors

bugs.description: Expert bug hunt, most severe first

checks.description: About 35 automated checks on the home page HTML and headers; null if the page couldn't be fetched raw

areaScores.description: 0-100 per area: accessibility, seo, security, performance, mobile, links, content

simulated.description: Always true: AI-simulated visitors, not real people

understoodPct.description: Share who understood what the site offers, 0-100

title: AI testers (10 synthetic users + QA report)
